review.notes: AliStore Staff is a retail back-office (ERP) app for electronics stores. Store staff use it for order processing, warehouse and service tasks, KPI, customer service, product intake and buyback. Access is role-based; a store provisions accounts for its own staff. App Review must receive an active demo staff account with representative non-production review data.
review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore Staff is the back-office app of a single electronics retail company in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. Store employees use it to process orders, run warehouse and service tasks, follow their KPI, serve customers at the counter, accept incoming goods and handle buyback. It is not a consumer app and is not usable without an employee account issued by the company.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Access is role-based and accounts are provisioned from the company ERP back office — there is no self-service registration inside the app, by design. We have created a dedicated review employee account with the Staff role and filled it in the Demo Account fields of this submission. The account is loaded with representative non-production review data (sample orders, tasks and customers), so nothing you do in review affects live retail operations. Sign in with the phone number and the one-time code flow described below: enter the demo phone number, tap Continue, and use the code we supply — if the code is not visible to you, request it through App Review Notes / Contact and we will relay the current one within minutes. If the demo account ever stops working during review, message us and we will re-issue it from the ERP immediately.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Every money, stock and status action is written to an append-only audit ledger on our server; the demo account is scoped to a review store so its entries stay isolated. Face ID is optional and only unlocks an already signed-in session. Push notifications carry task and order assignments only. The app does not track users and ships a privacy manifest declaring NSPrivacyTracking=false.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support. We monitor App Review messages continuously during review.

ru-KG.description: AliStore Staff — операционное ERP-приложение для розничных магазинов электроники. Персонал магазина обрабатывает заказы, выполняет складские и сервисные задачи, отслеживает KPI, обслуживает клиентов, принимает товары и ведёт операции скупки по регламентам магазина. Доступ ролевой: магазин выдаёт учётные записи своим сотрудникам.
